stances_toward.note: Rival, with cooling since April 2026. The FLA's aim is the total liberation of Azawad (AP): a territorial contest over the north, not a drive to end the Malian state, so adversary is not used. Our reading (C): no source uses the word rival for this pair. Bamako's airstrikes on FLA leaders (Tinzaouaten, December 2024) and the April 2026 offensive on Kidal are the evidence. Bond none.

relations_to.summary: The army's drone strike near Tinzaouaten on 1-2 December 2024, the day after the FLA was founded, reportedly killed several of its leaders (RFI, cited via Wikipedia). In April 2026 the FLA launched offensives and claimed Kidal (AP); the Africa Corps confirmed its withdrawal from Kidal (BBC).
